Featured Case Study

How We Cut Allianz
Malaysia's Energy Bill
by 70%

The brief: cut operating costs across two prime KL office towers without disrupting a working headquarters.


We audited 13 office floors. Within months, consumption dropped 16,400 kWh a month and the full investment paid back in under 18 months.


This became the proof of concept for our Shared Savings model.

Scope of Work
  • 13 office floors, two buildings
  • Menara Allianz Sentral + Plaza Central
  • Full M&E efficiency audit
  • HVAC, lighting & BMS optimisation
Results Delivered
  • 16,400 kWh/month reduction
  • RM 8,856 average monthly savings
  • Full payback in 1.4 years
  • Zero disruption to operations
How We Work

Models Built Around
Your Cashflow

01

Consulting Services

Full assessment across M&E, operations, and waste. Clear recommendations with quantified outcomes.

02

Shared Savings

Defined investment, savings, and payback per measure. Once results land, we share a percentage for an agreed period.

03

Co-Investing

On select projects, we co-invest directly. You get the efficiency gains immediately; we recover through a share of savings over an agreed period.

Best fit when
Savings are predictable and the baseline is measurable.
What you get
Implementation without capital outlay, and a partner invested in the result.
04

Power Purchase Agreement (PPA)

A solar system sized to your consumption. You pay below grid tariff for what it produces; surplus feeds back for credit.

Our Process

From Audit to Outcome

Step 01

Assess

We audit consumption across energy, water, and operations, and show you exactly where money is going.

Step 02

Propose

Specific measures, each with projected savings, investment, and payback. No padding.

Step 03

Implement

We source suppliers and manage the work. One accountable team, no handoff.

Step 04

Verify

Actual results tracked against projections, documented. We report on the numbers we committed to.
